Body.Content:
This update provides fixes for the latest versions of these Azure Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery Unified Setup and Site Recovery Mobility agent (both version 9.31.5449.1) for Windows Server, CentOS, and Ubuntu machines. Used for Azure virtual machine (VM) replication, and replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery configuration server OVF template (version 5.1.5300.0). Used for replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery Provider (version 5.1.5300.0). Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure.
  • Recovery Services agent (version 2.0.9165.0). Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure.

Learn more and get download links >
